    recent_transactions = get_most_recent_transactions(1)
    
    transaction = None

        if trans["sender"] == "me" and trans["recipient"] == friend_iban:
            transaction = trans

        # Send the money back to the friend

        print(f"Sent back {amount_to_send_back} to the friend.")
    else:
        print("No need to send money back, friend sent the correct amount.")
